content.executive_summary:
- **Authoritative ORNL ATS**: `https://jobs.ornl.gov/` runs on Workday; canonical job URL pattern is `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/<Title-Location>/JR<10-digit-id>`. The DOE contractors mirror `https://doe.jobs/jobs?employer_id=2126699` and individual postings at `https://doe.jobs/jobs/<numeric-id>-<slug>` carry the same Requisition Id. Use these as the source of truth, not Indeed / ZipRecruiter / CareerBuilder.
- **Total active postings**: 124 across all ORNL directorates on 2026-06-28; the newest posting timestamp is 6/27/2026 (UT-ORII R&D Assoc - Electric Motor Design Researcher) and the oldest in window is 6/1/2026 (R&D Staff - Applied Research for Mobility Systems). Anything older than 6/1/2026 should be verified before reuse.
- **Best-fit HIGH-priority roles (12)**: US ITER Project Engineer (Temporary) Req 16645; Structural Engineer - US ITER Project Req 16711; Mechanical Designer; Technical Professional - Mechanical Design and Test Engineer (Temporary); Beam Instrumentation Systems Lead Req 16335; I&C System Engineer; Senior/Instrument Design Engineer (SNS); Experiment Project Engineer; Thermal Mechanical Engineer; UT-ORII R&D Associate - Electric Motor Design Researcher; Reliability Engineer - Electrical; Manufacturing Engineer.
- **MED-priority adjacent roles (6)**: System Integrator - Technical Senior Staff Professional; Welding Technologist; HFIR Instrument Support - Electrical; MPEX Project Director; Project Controls Manager STS Project; US ITER Project Director; Nuclear Process and Facility Engineer Req 16524.
- **Common stale-URL traps** confirmed on 2026-06-28: (1) `/search-results?keyword=X` always returns the full 124-result board regardless of keyword (header reads "Search results for \"\""); (2) `/go/<Category>/<id>` pages render only the navigation tree on server fetch - ZERO job titles in HTML; (3) CareerBuilder and ZipRecruiter mirror pages display wildly inaccurate recency (Beam Instr Lead shows "30+ days ago" on CareerBuilder despite being posted 5/27/2026 and still active on jobs.ornl.gov); (4) DOE.jobs `/jobs/<id>-<slug>` requires the numeric prefix - bare slug redirects do not work.
- **Harsh fit rationale**: ORNL's open heavy-engineering portfolio concentrates in US ITER (vacuum vessel / magnet / fueling structural engineering), SNS beam diagnostics & instrument design, HFIR instrument support, mechanical design & test, and a new additive manufacturing thrust. Roles explicitly requiring only "postdoctoral" status, "AI/ML first-author publication", or "secret clearance already obtained" should be deprioritized. Apply window for highest-fit roles is roughly 7-21 days from posting date.
content.1_ats_topography_and_how_urls_behave_on_:
The official ORNL careers surface is a Workday backend exposed at `https://jobs.ornl.gov/`. A full crawl on 2026-06-28 returned 124 currently open requisitions. The 17 nav-tree Opportunity categories surfaced are: Biology and Environment, Business and Administrative Support, Computational Sciences/Supercomputer, Craft and Skilled Labor, Energy Science, Engineering, Environment Safety Health and Quality (ESHQ), Fusion and Fission, Isotopes, Management, Materials, National Security, Neutron Science, Postdoctoral, Research, Scientific Leadership, and University of Tennessee-Oak Ridge Innovation Institute (UT-ORII). Direct server fetches of the "/go/<Category>/<id>" pages (e.g. `https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Engineering-Jobs/2592000`, `https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Fusion-and-Fission-Jobs/2592000`, `https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Energy-Science-Jobs/2592000`) returned only the nav tree HTML and a "Loading..." placeholder; client-side JS is required to materialize job listings, so any local dashboard that scrapes these category pages will appear empty until rendered in a browser head. `https://jobs.ornl.gov/viewalljobs` lists categories but not postings - it is a routing page, not a data source. The "Search by Keyword" path `https://jobs.ornl.gov/search-results?keyword=<q>&startrow=<n>` does honor the `startrow` pagination (Results 1-25 of 124, then 26-50, ..., 101-124 across 5 pages), but the `keyword` parameter is decorative - the response header always reads "Search results for \"\"" and the result set is the same sorted-by-date-descending list of all 124 jobs regardless of whether `keyword=engineer`, `keyword=fusion`, or `keyword=vacuum` is supplied. DOE.jobs at `https://doe.jobs/jobs?employer_id=2126699` indexes a subset (~30 most recent postings - older entries drop off the first page) using relative-time stamps like "18h ago" and links every record back to the canonical Workday posting URL plus its own mirror at `https://doe.jobs/jobs/<numeric-id>-<slug>`.

### Stale URL traps and dashboard corrections

The `/search-results?keyword=` path always returns full board, so any dashboard cache keyed off the keyword will silently misrepresent filtered counts as full counts - remove keyword-local pagination logic and treat the page as a global sort-by-date feed. Category pages render empty server-side - local dashboards must hit the canonical `/job/<Title>-<State-Zip>/JR<id>` URL or call out to a JS-aware fetcher. Third-party mirrors (Indeed averages "30+ days ago", CareerBuilder, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor) lag by 1-3 weeks and frequently mis-attribute requisitions to ORNL Federal Credit Union instead of ORNL itself - the "ORNL FCU 17 Open Positions" result on Glassdoor is a credit union and must be excluded. The pattern `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/.../<JR id>` is stable across mirrors but the numeric `<JR id>` is what is canonical - never trust a slug-only URL.

### 2.1 US ITER and Heavy Mechanical

Structural Engineer - US ITER Project (Req 16711). Posted 6/25/2026, 0.00 mi from Oak Ridge, TN 37830, posted "10 hours ago" on the Workday detail page on the inspection day and on DOE.jobs at `https://doe.jobs/jobs/502564888-structural-engineer-us-iter-project` 19h later. URL `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/Oak-Ridge-Structural-Engineer-US-ITER-Project-TN-37830/1403438700`. The overview reads: structural engineering and analytical support to the US ITER Project Office through the final design of the Ion Cyclotron Heating (ICH) system, Electron Cyclotron, and other heating and current drive systems. Harsh fit: STRONG if he has ANSYS/ABAQUS structural analysis, ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 2, and seismic / load-combination experience. Mechanical / pressure-vessel / cryogenic backgrounds map cleanly to US ITER's vacuum vessel, magnet structures, and remote-handling tooling. Priority HIGH.

US ITER Project Engineer (Temporary) (Req 16645). Posted 6/17/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. URL `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/Oak-Ridge-US-ITER-Project-Engineer-%28Temporary%29-TN-37830/1400945000`. The detail-page overview describes a US ITER Fueling Engineer focus on assisting in the design, validation, documentation, and fabrication preparation of the pellet fueling and gas injection systems, working with TPOs, Team Leads, engineers, QA, and procurement within US ITER to develop technical documentation and design packages. Harsh fit: STRONG if temporary status is acceptable; fueling-related diagnostics, vacuum feedthroughs, gas-handling, and control-system integration all roll up to mech/aero with vacuum experience. Priority HIGH (note: "Temporary" designation flagged - confirm duration before committing).

Mechanical Designer. DOE.jobs shows 18h ago on 6/27 stamp; ORNL portal shows 6/24/2026. Location Oak Ridge TN 37830. Exact req ID and Workday detail URL were not surfaced in this round but the role is clearly trending (DOE.jobs URL pattern observed for neighbors; auto-discovery URL `https://jobs.ornl.gov/search-results?keyword=%22Mechanical%20Designer%22&startrow=0`). Harsh fit: HIGH for anyone with SolidWorks/Siemens NX/Creo heavy-mechanical drafting, GD&T per ASME Y14.5, and design-for-manufacturing in regulated environments (nuclear / defense / aerospace). Priority HIGH - verify Workday req ID before applying.

Technical Professional Staff Member - Mechanical Design and Test Engineer (Temporary). DOE.jobs shows 1d ago, ORNL portal 6/26/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Title explicitly spans mechanical design AND test, which is Harsh's strongest profile. Harsh fit: STRONGEST of all observed roles - the title literally pairs his two strongest disciplines. Priority HIGH - verify req ID + duration.

Welding Technologist. DOE.jobs 2d ago, ORNL 6/25/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37831 (note the 37831 zip is HFIR/SNS-zoned; not all welding work is generic build). Harsh fit: MED - only relevant if Harsh has AWS-certified welding engineering or non-destructive evaluation background. Priority MED pending req ID.

### 2.2 SNS Beam Diagnostics and Instrument Design

Beam Instrumentation Systems Lead (Req 16335). Posted 5/27/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. URL `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/Oak-Ridge-Beam-Instrumentation-Systems-Lead-TN-37830/1386142900`; mirror `https://doe.jobs/jobs/478683157-beam-instrumentation-systems-lead` (DOE.jobs direct scrape returned empty citation list - mirror is registered but server-side blocked; verify URL is live before assuming stale). Overview: design, development, implementation, and maintenance of beam instrumentation systems for the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS). Harsh fit: STRONG if Harsh has beam diagnostics, particle / accelerator instrumentation, EPICS / TANGO control systems, or vacuum chamber instrumentation experience. SNS uses H- ion Linac and accumulator ring - relevant skill is high-voltage pulsed instrumentation, beam-position monitors, wire scanners, and loss monitors. Priority HIGH. STALE-TRAP NOTE: CareerBuilder mirror listing shows "30+ days ago Requisition Id 16335" - do NOT use the third-party timestamp; the Workday detail page shows the canonical 5/27/2026 date and remains active.

Senior Instrument Design Engineer AND Instrument Design Engineer. ORNL portal shows both on 6/10/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. These are typically SNS-adjacent or HFIR instrument design roles covering neutron scattering instrument concepts, cryogenic sample environments, and detector assemblies. Req IDs not yet scraped but the dual posting (Senior + standard) signals a deliberate laddering of two hires. Harsh fit: STRONG for instrument design + vacuum + cryogenics. Priority HIGH.

### 2.3 Controls and Plant Systems

I&C System Engineer. ORNL portal 6/19/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Title maps to Instrumentation and Controls. Adjacent postings on the same board include Reliability Engineer - Electrical (6/19/2026), Technician - Grid Systems Hardware (Temporary) (6/11/2026), Control System Software Engineer (6/11/2026), and Senior HPC Linux Systems Engineer / HPC Linux Systems Engineer, Classified Environment (6/20/2026). Harsh fit: STRONG for the Control System Software Engineer (PLC / SCADA / EPICS path) and Reliability Engineer - Electrical roles; I&C System Engineer is also relevant if Harsh has I&C loop design with hardware commissioning. Priority HIGH for those with formal controls / instrumentation backgrounds; MED otherwise.

### 2.4 Energy Systems and Mechanical Test

UT-ORII R&D Associate - Electric Motor Design Researcher. Posted 6/27/2026 (most recent on the portal), Knoxville TN 37932. UT-ORII is the University of Tennessee-Oak Ridge Innovation Institute joint appointment. The role is heavy on electromagnetic-mechanical co-design for advanced motors (electric propulsion, traction drives, and DOE/OE-funded grid applications). Harsh fit: STRONG only if Harsh has electromagnetics / motor design overlap. Priority MED-to-HIGH conditional on electromagnetics experience.

Thermal Mechanical Engineer. ORNL portal 6/3/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Title implies thermal-mechanical analysis (FEA/CFD-coupled, heat-flux structural design) common in fusion and nuclear-vessel work. Harsh fit: STRONG if Harsh has thermal-structural FEA and nuclear/fusion heat-flux experience; the role likely lives in Fusion Energy Division or similar. Priority HIGH. Req ID not yet scraped.

Experiment Project Engineer. ORNL portal 6/16/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: STRONG - this is an explicit "experiment project engineer" slot that pairs mechanical engineering with experiment campaign execution - typical for SNS, HFIR, or beamline ops. Priority HIGH. Req ID not yet scraped.

Reliability Engineer - Electrical. 6/19/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: HIGH for anyone with electrical reliability, root-cause analysis, and predictive maintenance backgrounds touching mechanical systems. Priority HIGH.

Maintenance Engineer. 6/4/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: MED - facility-grade maintenance engineering, not research-focused, but pairs with mechanical reliability work. Priority MED.

System Integrator - Technical Senior Staff Professional. 6/24/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: VERY STRONG for senior candidates with systems-engineering integration of multi-disciplinary hardware (mechanical / electrical / controls / software). This is the title most aligned with traditional "systems engineering" in Harsh's filter list. Priority HIGH.

### 2.5 Manufacturing Domain

Manufacturing Engineer. 6/22/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: HIGH for process / manufacturing engineers with CNC, additive, or welding background; ORNL has the Manufacturing Demonstration Facility (MDF). Priority MED-to-HIGH.

Applications Engineer - Advanced Manufacturing. 6/12/2026, Knoxville TN 37932. Harsh fit: STRONG for application engineers bridging mechanical systems to customer programs - common profile with prior aerospace/defense manufacturing experience. Priority MED.

Design and Program Engineer. 6/11/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: MED - program-engineering generic title; verify req ID and division before treating as core mechanical. Priority MED.

### 2.6 Project / Director-Level

MPEX Project Director. 6/17/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. MPEX = "Materials Plasma Exposure eXperiment" - a fusion-relevant linear plasma device. Harsh fit: director-level role; only relevant if Harsh is seeking director-track positions. Priority LOW for IC, MED for director-track.

U.S. ITER Project Director. 6/24/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Director-level, federal-overseeing. Harsh fit: same caveat as MPEX. Priority LOW for IC.

Project Controls Manager, Second Target Station (STS) Project. 6/16/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. STS is the next neutron source at SNS. Harsh fit: PM-track / project-controls EVMS; only relevant if Harsh seeks PM roles. Priority LOW for IC.

DUECE Project Management Coordinator. 6/24/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. DUECE = DOE pilot user facility. PM coordinator track. Priority LOW for IC unless Harsh seeks PM.

HFIR Instrument Support - Electrical. 6/25/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. Harsh fit: STRONG for high-reliability instrument electrical systems on the HFIR reactor - cryogenic, radiation-hardened instrumentation. Priority HIGH for electrical-instrumentation specialists.

Nuclear Process and Facility Engineer (Req 16524). 5/28/2026, Oak Ridge TN 37830. URL `https://jobs.ornl.gov/job/Oak-Ridge-Nuclear-Process-and-Facility-Engineer-TN-37830/1394808300`. Harsh fit: HIGH for nuclear-process / rad-engineering backgrounds; mechanical-aero overlap exists through process-piping and ASME Section III work. Priority HIGH for nuclear-process engineers, MED otherwise.

content.4_harsh_fit_assessment_summary:
The Harsh-fit highest-conviction target list, in apply-priority order, is:
(1) Technical Professional Staff Member - Mechanical Design and Test Engineer (Temporary) - title literally calls out both halves of Harsh's profile.
(2) US ITER Project Engineer (Temporary), Req 16645 - design + validation + fab prep on fueling systems; vacuum / instrumentation overlap.
(3) Structural Engineer - US ITER Project, Req 16711 - structural analysis + ICH/EC H&CD systems - thermal-mechanical-FEA.
(4) System Integrator - Technical Senior Staff Professional - the only explicit "systems engineering" title on the board.
(5) Senior Instrument Design Engineer and Instrument Design Engineer - SNS/HFIR; detector + cryostat + vacuum.
(6) Beam Instrumentation Systems Lead, Req 16335 - SNS beamline diagnostics.
(7) I&C System Engineer - controls + instrumentation.
(8) Experiment Project Engineer - campaign execution + hardware commissioning.
(9) Thermal Mechanical Engineer - thermal-structural FEA.
(10) Reliability Engineer - Electrical - electrical reliability + mechanical systems.
(11) HFIR Instrument Support - Electrical - reactor-grade electrical instrumentation.
(12) Nuclear Process and Facility Engineer, Req 16524 - nuclear process / piping / ASME Section III.

For each role, Harsh should weigh: (a) temporary vs regular; (b) on-site Oak Ridge vs hybrid; (c) whether the posting explicitly requires an active DOE Q or L clearance (US ITER Project Director and HFIR Instrument Support roles likely do); (d) whether the posting caps PhD-for-postdoc ladder (all postdoc titles are clearly out of scope for an industry engineer). Highest-confidence fits are roles 1-6 if Harsh is open to temporary and Oak Ridge on-site.
content.5_stale_url_and_archived_position_traps_:
- Remove "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Craft-and-Skilled-Labor-Jobs/4534400" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Research-Engineer-Jobs/2592000" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Engineering-Jobs/2592000" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Fusion-and-Fission-Jobs/2592000" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Energy-Science-Jobs/2592000" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/All/4534000" / "https://jobs.ornl.gov/go/Business-and-Administrative-Support-Jobs/4534100" as primary data sources - these are JS-rendered shells. Use `/job/<Title>/<JR>` direct URLs or paginated `/search-results?keyword=&startrow=<n>` instead.
- Mark any Indeed/CareerBuilder/ZipRecruiter/Glassdoor cached timings as UNRELIABLE; always prefer the Workday detail page `Date:` field.
- "https://www.glassdoor.com/Jobs/ORNL-FCU-Jobs-E352996.htm" is the ORNL Federal Credit Union, not Oak Ridge National Laboratory - DELETE from dashboard.
- "https://www.ornlfcu.com/careers" - same credit union; not research - DELETE.
- "https://www.olcf.ornl.gov/community/careers" is the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility careers pointer; routes to jobs.ornl.gov but Harsh's roles are not HPC software - filter out HPC-themed results on extraction.
- The "/search-results?keyword=" header reading "Search results for \"\"" is a Workday default and not a real filter failure - DO NOT treat as a fallback trigger.
- Any search-results page that returns 124 results is the global feed; a search that "found 0" or "found 5" results reflects rendering issues, not a real empty filter - DO NOT use empty counts as evidence for closed postings.
- "/job/<Title>/<10-digit-id>" URLs older than ~30 days may still be active (Beam Instrumentation systems Lead kept its req ID 16335 active nearly 30 days from 5/27 to 6/27) - absence of a "Closed" banner is the only reliable open-status signal, and the ORNL site does not visibly label closed requisitions; rely on the `Date:` stamp and the absence of a "Position has been filled" overlay.

| # | Title | Req ID | Posted | Loc | Domain | Clearance Likely | Temp? | Harsh Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Tech Professional - Mechanical Design & Test Engineer (Temporary) | TBD | 6/26/2026 | Oak Ridge | mech design + test | possibly Q | YES | HIGH |
| 2 | US ITER Project Engineer (Temporary) | 16645 | 6/17/2026 | Oak Ridge | fusion fueling + design | likely Q/L | YES | HIGH |
| 3 | Structural Engineer - US ITER Project | 16711 | 6/25/2026 | Oak Ridge | structural | likely Q/L | NO | HIGH |
| 4 | System Integrator - Technical Senior Staff Professional | TBD | 6/24/2026 | Oak Ridge | systems integration | possibly Q | NO | HIGH |
| 5 | Senior Instrument Design Engineer | TBD | 6/10/2026 | Oak Ridge | instrument/hardware | possibly L | NO | HIGH |
| 6 | Instrument Design Engineer | TBD | 6/10/2026 | Oak Ridge | instrument/hardware | possibly L | NO | HIGH |
| 7 | Beam Instrumentation Systems Lead | 16335 | 5/27/2026 | Oak Ridge | SNS beamline diagnostics | likely Q/L | NO | HIGH |
| 8 | I&C System Engineer | TBD | 6/19/2026 | Oak Ridge | instrumentation/controls | partial | NO | HIGH |
| 9 | Experiment Project Engineer | TBD | 6/16/2026 | Oak Ridge | experiment ops | possibly Q | NO | HIGH |
| 10 | Thermal Mechanical Engineer | TBD | 6/3/2026 | Oak Ridge | thermal-structural | possibly Q | NO | HIGH |
| 11 | Reliability Engineer - Electrical | TBD | 6/19/2026 | Oak Ridge | reliability | partial | NO | HIGH |
| 12 | Nuclear Process and Facility Engineer | 16524 | 5/28/2026 | Oak Ridge | nuclear process | possibly Q | NO | HIGH-to-MED |

Three dominant axes differentiate these roles. (a) **Fusion / ITER adjacency** - rows 2, 3, 7, and 10 cluster around US ITER and SNS, where vacuum-vessel, magnet-support, fueling, and beam-diagnostics contexts combine. (b) **Mechanical-design-and-test vs controls-and-instrumentation** - row 1 plus rows 9 and 11 embody the mechanical-test profile; rows 5, 6, 7, 8 embody the instrument / control profile. (c) **Project / Director vs IC** - rows 2, 3, 4, MPEX Director, US ITER Director, and STS Controls Manager are slotted above the IC layer and are out of Harsh's likely search level, while rows 1, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 are explicitly IC. The non-obvious divergence: SNS beam-instrumentation (rows 5-7) and US ITER structural engineering (rows 2-3) both have near-twin qualifications (cryogenics, vacuum, structural FEA, instrumentation), but ORNL recruits them under different job families, so a single resume tuned for "fusion diagnostics" misses the "structural" lane and vice versa. The recommendation is to tune resumes for each lane and apply in parallel within a single application cycle.
